theorems.name: Submission.dohr_lmo_weight_restrict_eq
theorems.statement: ∀ n ℓ : ℕ, ∀ (U : Set (Amb n ℓ)) (V : RectifiableVarifold n ℓ U) (O : Set (Amb n ℓ)), MeasurableSet O → (∀ᵐ x ∂V.weight, x ∈ O → V.mult x = 1) → (μHE[n] : Measure (Amb n ℓ)) (symmDiff (V.carrier ∩ O) (V.support ∩ O)) = 0 → V.weight.restrict O = (μHE[n] : Measure (Amb n ℓ)).restrict (V.support ∩ O)
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
